seoTitle: Gravel, Mulch & Soil Calculator: Cubic Yards, Tons and Bags
metaDescription: Work out how much gravel, mulch, topsoil or sand to order for an area and depth: volume, weight and number of bags, with a waste allowance.
intro: Enter the size of the bed or driveway and the depth to see how much material to buy.
why:
Volume is length times width times depth, converted to cubic yards, cubic metres and cubic feet, with an allowance for waste or compaction (10% by default). Weight uses typical densities per cubic yard for gravel, mulch, topsoil, sand and crushed stone, and the bag count divides by the bag size you enter.

Density varies a lot with moisture and grading, so ask your supplier for the weight of the actual product and round the order up.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Pick the material and waste percentage.

faq.a: Mulch 2 to 3 inches, topsoil 4 to 6, gravel paths 2 to 4, driveways 4 to 6 over a base.
Material compacts and some is lost in spreading.
No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
